academies.name: MultiCloud, DevOps & AI Bootcamp
academies.blurb: A hands-on, self-paced bootcamp spanning computing fundamentals, four cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud), DevOps, and AI — plus certification maps, three guided missions, and a full career-strategy block. Every module pairs concept lessons with click-by-click labs and original end-to-end builds: the CivicWorks municipal services portal, the FieldMedic AI triage assistant, and multi-cloud migration capstones. **Noah**, the built-in AI tutor, checks in after every lesson with adaptive questions and personal remediation paths.
